species.tagline: The one cooing downstairs every morning

tasks.title: Look at its neck
tasks.message: A black patch covered in white spots, like a beaded necklace — that is the “spotted” part of its name.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a spotted dove. The black patch on its neck is covered in white spots.

tasks.title: All over Hong Kong
tasks.message: Parks, housing estates, the school gate — you will see it walking on the ground looking for seeds.
tasks.subtitle: You will find it in parks and at the school gate, walking about looking for seeds.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: If one walks past, stand still and watch. Do not chase it.
tasks.subtitle: Stand still and watch instead of chasing, and it will stay. Thank you!
